title: Protest Planned in Support of NEET-CBSE Students
summary: The founder of the 'Cockroach Janta Party' announced plans for a peaceful protest in Delhi on June 6, advocating for the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan in support of NEET-CBSE students.
summary_points: Abhijit Dipke, founder of the 'Cockroach Janta Party', announced his return to India on June 6.
He plans to lead a peaceful protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi.
The protest aims to demand the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.
The demonstration is in support of NEET-CBSE students.
title_hi: NEET-CBSE छात्रों के समर्थन में प्रदर्शन की योजना
summary_hi: 'कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी' के संस्थापक ने NEET-CBSE छात्रों के समर्थन में शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर 6 जून को दिल्ली में शांतिपूर्ण प्रदर्शन की योजना की घोषणा की।
summary_points_hi: 'कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी' के संस्थापक अभिजीत दीपके ने 6 जून को भारत लौटने की घोषणा की।
वह दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर शांतिपूर्ण प्रदर्शन करने की योजना बना रहे हैं।
प्रदर्शन का उद्देश्य शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान के इस्तीफे की मांग करना है।
यह प्रदर्शन NEET-CBSE छात्रों के समर्थन में है।

center.framing: Center-leaning outlets provide general news coverage, including reports on consumer issues, murder cases, temple incidents, and sports news, without specific focus on the NEET-CBSE student protest or related controversies.

right.framing: Right-leaning outlets report on the planned protest by the 'Cockroach Janta Party' in support of NEET-CBSE students, mentioning the founder Abhijit Dipke.

divergence: Coverage diverges significantly, with left-leaning outlets focusing on the planned protest for the Education Minister's resignation and raising questions about alleged scams and delayed clarifications related to the education ministry. The right-leaning outlet also reports on the planned protest but without the critical framing seen in the left-leaning coverage. Center-leaning outlets do not cover this specific event, instead focusing on a variety of other unrelated news topics.
omissions: Center-leaning outlets omit any coverage of the planned protest by the 'Cockroach Janta Party' or the related issues concerning NEET-CBSE students and the Education Minister.
